text:
“142 DI today.” That is what the daily report said. Here is what a number like that can hide.

→ 6 welders produced 60% of it.
→ 4 welders haven't crossed 3 DI a day all month.
→ Fit-up is 2 days ahead of welding, and the joint backlog is growing.

I built a single-file HTML dashboard that shows exactly this: a 30-day matrix with every welder and every day, the fit-up vs welding gap, and productivity rankings. No Power BI, no server. One file that opens on a phone.

The demo runs on fictional data: https://osman2k4-dot.github.io/Dashboards/demo-welder-productivity.html

How do you track welder-level performance on your project?

#ProjectControls #Piping #Welding #EPC #Productivity
